# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** rose-red  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid, black-eyed girl. She carries off the palm for beauty among the Second Year classes at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

She is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious. Stella possesses a heartful of wistful dreams and fancies that are as aerial and rainbow-like as Anne Shirley's.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- ambitious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attends Queen's Academy, where she is part of the Second Year classes and is recognized for her beauty. During her time at the Academy, she becomes part of a close circle of friends alongside Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Affiliations

- Queen’s Academy — student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
